chartEmpty: No history for these filters. Run npm run import:prices regularly to build the chart.

colHints.marketValue: Current value from the Cardmarket trend price (price × quantity).
colHints.marketVar: Change in market value over the selected period (Cardmarket price at the start of the period → current price).
colHints.invested: Sum of the purchase prices you entered.
colHints.purchasePnL: Profit or loss over the selected period: from the market price at the start of the period, or from the purchase price for cards bought during the period (purchase date, otherwise date added) (only rows with a purchase price). With “All”: current market value minus entered purchase price.
colHints.card: Card or product name and number.
colHints.purchase: Total purchase price entered for this row.
colHints.market: Current Cardmarket price: per unit and total for the quantity owned.

emptyFiltered: No owned cards match these filters.
detailHint: {count} {noun}. Enter a purchase price on a card sheet to compute profit or loss.
emptyCatalog: No cards in the database. Run
